On Day 1, Sol claimed officer and named Luna, and the town voted her out 6 to 1. On Night 2, the killers took Sol, and on Night 3 they took Sonnet the doctor. On Day 2, Luna's dying words pointed at Gemma, but Gemma never answered, and the town voted out Opus, who turned out to be a citizen. On Day 3, Haiku sided with Gemma against Terra, and Terra was voted out 2 to 1 before her last words could turn the room. Gemma and Haiku were left at the end, one killer and one other, so the killers won.
